page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 12 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing 12 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance includes 670 GB of local SSD storage, offering direct-attached solid-state capacity for applications requiring fast local disk access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.i1.3xlarge provides a stable resource profile. The inclusion of 670 GB of local SSD storage makes it a cost-efficient option for workloads that require a combination of dedicated compute resources and local storage without the overhead of external network-attached storage. Suitable workloads include general-purpose applications, relational databases, caching layers, and mid-sized web serving environments.
